title: The Midnight Laundry
subtitle: A sanctuary for niche fragrance in the heart of the night.
line: Step into a space where the rhythm of a midnight laundry machine distills memories into scent.
quote: The scent of clean air, held in the warmth of a spinning drum.
synopsis: You enter a space defined by the hum of a rotating laundry drum, its hypnotic motion mirroring the complexity of the fragrances within. As warm steam fills the air, you are invited to wander between the industrial aluminum shelves that store delicate scents like detergents of the mind. The journey concludes at a weathered concrete counter, where the lingering scent of fresh laundry meets the depth of niche perfume. Here, the everyday act of cleaning is transformed into a profound olfactory ritual.

why.d: Shelf walls (industrial laundry shelf walls) wrap the left, right and back of the 12 x 10 m room. The aluminum shelves create a sterile yet evocative industrial environment that frames the fragrance collection.

The centre object (spinning laundry drum centerpiece) is the first stop, 4.2 m in from the door. The central drum serves as a kinetic centerpiece that anchors the space and draws you into a rhythmic, sensory experience.
The route circles it first, then follows the shelves. The layout encourages a contemplative path, allowing you to gradually immerse yourself in the fragrance discovery process.

The counter (steaming laundry reception counter) sits at the back, off the loop. The concrete counter acts as a grounding anchor at the end of the ritual, offering a tactile contrast to the ethereal scents.
